ratings_why.fun: One pile of Kits pulled three ways (fight HP, falling missiles, permanent stats) gives a real choice every turn, and the board visibly swells.
ratings_why.distinct: The off-board Burrow and the passing Banner feel fresh, but Kit size plus summon-on-death reads close to familiar token and reborn tribes.

verdict_why: Cards now read cleanly apart from one wording slip on Snow Hall Guard; another round would mostly reshuffle numbers, not improve the read.

points.text: Snow Hall Guard's "Burrow Kits included" can mean what it counts or who gets the buff. Say "All your Kits, in the Burrow too, gain +1/+1 for every 4 Kits in your Burrow".
Front Lemming reads faster as an event: "The first 3 times your front unit dies, a Kit from your Burrow takes its slot." The no-use-up clause then goes away.
Boom and crash, the seed's loudest theme, is only half here: Herald booms, but no card crashes. A card that pays when the Herd suddenly shrinks would carry the lemming year.
The Turn order rule and the Burrow-only spenders are a real puzzle but invisible on cards; a small spend-order marker on each Start/End of Turn unit would let players read it at a glance.
Identical Cousin is long and its fantasy is loose; tying it to lemmings looking alike (copy only onto a Kit beside a Lemming) would read as the tribe, not a utility card.

standouts.why: Ole drops lemmings from the sky on enemies: the myth turned into one plain line.
Brother Onward's growing Banner makes 'whoever is in front leads' something you watch happen.
Ferrywife reads instantly and the Wide Water crossing gives the spend a story.

weakest.why: Longest text in the tribe, and it's a generic copy tool more than a lemming.
Tunic Weaver is a plain stat pick with no woodland flavour in what it does.
Herding Council's spend-2-for-size is fine but flat; nothing about meeting on the move shows.

flags.note: "Burrow Kits included" is ambiguous between counting and receiving the buff.
Herald with Litter Keeper adds up to 10 Kits a turn; caps hold it, but Kit size growth stacks on top.
Golden Cantor on a long Onward chain could put very large fight stats on one unit.
The Burrow is off-board, so opponents need its count shown on the hero to read a board.
